footer.blurb: The open-source investigation platform for your data. Classifyre scans the systems you already run, detects secrets, PII, and the signals you define, then works the findings like a detective — standing inquiries, ranked evidence, cases, and an AI autopilot between scans.

cookie.message: We use analytics cookies to see which pages get read, nothing else. No ads, no profiling, no data sold. Decline and the site works exactly the same.
